.lk-st{display:none!important}
.lk-home{grid-column:1/-1;max-width:1040px;min-width:0}.lk-home *{overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.lk-home a.lk-need{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}.lk-home a.lk-need:hover b{text-decoration:underline}
.lk-home .lk-live{display:contents}.lk-acc:has(.cv-personal) #personal{display:none}
.lk-lock{position:relative;z-index:1;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;margin:0;font:600 12px var(--font);border:1px solid var(--ink);border-radius:var(--r-pill);color:var(--ink);background:var(--bg);white-space:nowrap;overflow-wrap:normal}
.lk-lock.on{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink)}
.lk-lock>b,.lk-lock .btn{display:block;font:600 12px var(--font);padding:4px 10px 4px 25px;line-height:16px}
.lk-lock .btn{all:unset;cursor:pointer;padding:4px 10px 4px 25px;border-radius:var(--r-pill);line-height:16px}.lk-lock .btn:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:2px}
.lk-lock:has(.btn)>b{display:none}
.lk-lock::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:10px;top:50%;width:9px;height:7px;margin-top:-1px;border-radius:1.5px;background:currentColor;pointer-events:none}
.lk-lock::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:11.5px;top:50%;width:6px;height:5px;margin-top:-6px;box-sizing:border-box;border:1.5px solid currentColor;border-bottom:0;border-radius:3px 3px 0 0;pointer-events:none}
.lk-lock .cv-locknote:empty{display:none}.lk-lock .cv-locknote:not(:empty){position:absolute;right:0;top:calc(100% + 6px);width:max-content;max-width:260px;white-space:normal;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-s);padding:4px 8px;font-weight:500;z-index:2}
.lk-limit{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-l);padding:var(--s3) var(--s4);margin:0 0 var(--s3);background:var(--page);line-height:1.45}
.lk-limit b{color:var(--ink)}.lk-limit small{display:block;color:var(--ink-2,inherit);opacity:.8}
.lk-bub{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:var(--s3);margin:0 0 var(--s3)}
.lk-b{display:block;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-l);padding:var(--s3) var(--s4);color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none;background:var(--page)}
.lk-b.open,.lk-b:focus-visible{border-color:var(--accent);background:var(--bg)}
.lk-b h2{font-size:var(--fs-3);font-weight:800;margin:0 0 var(--s2);display:flex;justify-content:space-between}
.lk-b h2::after{content:"\203A";color:var(--muted)}.lk-b.open h2::after{content:"\2039";transform:rotate(90deg)}
.lk-f{display:flex;gap:var(--s4)}.lk-f>span{display:flex;flex-direction:column;font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}
.lk-f b{font-size:22px;font-weight:800;color:var(--ink);white-space:nowrap;line-height:1.2}
.lk-p{display:none;border:1px solid var(--accent);border-radius:var(--r-l);padding:var(--s4);margin-bottom:var(--s3)}
.lk-p:target,.lk-p.open{display:block}.lk-p h2{font-size:var(--fs-4);font-weight:800;margin-top:0}
.lk-p h3{font-size:var(--fs-2);font-weight:800;margin:var(--s4) 0 var(--s2);padding-top:var(--s3);border-top:1px solid var(--line)}

.lk-acct.hd{margin-bottom:var(--s1);font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted)}
.lk-acct>b{font-weight:700;font-size:var(--fs-0);padding-top:2px}.lk-acct p{margin:2px 0 0;font-size:12px}
.lk-bar2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 44px;gap:var(--s2);align-items:center}
.lk-bar2>span:last-child{font-weight:700;font-size:var(--fs-0);text-align:right}
.lk-trk{position:relative;display:block;height:8px;border-radius:var(--r-pill);background:var(--soft-2)}
.lk-trk i{position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;left:0;border-radius:var(--r-pill);background:var(--accent)}
.lk-trk i.hot{background:var(--hot)}.lk-trk i.ok{background:var(--ok)}
.lk-trk s{position:absolute;top:-4px;width:2px;height:16px;background:var(--ink)}
.lk-hotw{color:var(--hot);font-weight:600}.lk-bl{display:none;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
.lk-key{display:grid;grid-template-columns:130px 1fr 170px;gap:var(--s5);align-items:center;font-size:var(--fs-0);margin-bottom:var(--s2)}
.lk-key>span:last-child{color:var(--muted)}
.lk-dd{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-l);margin:var(--s3) 0}

.lk-dd>summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}.lk-dd>summary b{font-size:var(--fs-3);font-weight:800}
.lk-dd>summary small{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
.lk-dd>summary::after{content:"\203A";margin-left:auto;color:var(--muted);font-size:var(--fs-4)}.lk-dd[open]>summary::after{transform:rotate(90deg)}
.lk-dd>div{padding:0 var(--s4) var(--s4)}.lk-p .lk-dd{margin-bottom:0}
.lk-home .lk-tl{container-type:inline-size}.lk-home .lk-tl .tl-line{margin:0}
.lk-stack{display:flex}.lk-stack img{width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;margin-left:-6px;border:2px solid var(--bg);background:var(--portrait);filter:var(--portrait-filter)}.lk-stack img:first-child{margin-left:0}
.lk-team{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:var(--s4);align-items:center}
.lk-team a{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none;font-weight:600}
.lk-team img{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;filter:var(--portrait-filter)}
.lk-cols{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,680px) minmax(0,336px);gap:var(--s5);align-items:start}
.lk-h{font-size:var(--fs-4);font-weight:800;margin:var(--s4) 0 var(--s2)}.lk-h small{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:500;margin-left:8px}
.lk-rh{display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between;gap:var(--s3);flex-wrap:wrap}
.lk-sort{all:unset;cursor:pointer;font-size:var(--fs-0);font-weight:600;color:var(--accent);white-space:nowrap}.lk-sort:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent)}
.lk-flt{display:flex;gap:6px;overflow-x:auto;padding-bottom:var(--s2);margin-bottom:var(--s1)}
.lk-ch{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;font:600 12px var(--font);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-pill);padding:3px 9px;white-space:nowrap;overflow-wrap:normal;color:var(--ink);background:var(--bg)}
button.lk-ch{cursor:pointer}.lk-ch small{color:var(--muted);font-weight:500}
.lk-ch[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--ink);color:var(--bg);border-color:var(--ink)}.lk-ch[aria-pressed="true"] small{color:var(--bg)}
.lk-dot{display:inline-block;width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent);flex:none}
.lk-qm{display:inline-block;width:8px;height:8px;box-sizing:border-box;border-radius:2px;border:1px dashed var(--grey-fg);flex:none}
.lk-card{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:var(--s3);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-m);padding:var(--s3);margin-bottom:var(--s2)}
.lk-card .t{flex:1;min-width:0}.lk-card .t b{display:block;font-size:16px;font-weight:700}.lk-card .t span{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}
.lk-card.lk-run{display:block}.lk-r1{display:flex;gap:var(--s3);align-items:flex-start}
.lk-rt{text-align:right;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);display:grid;gap:4px;justify-items:end}
.lk-faces{display:flex;flex:none}.lk-faces img{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid var(--bg);filter:var(--portrait-filter)}.lk-faces img+img{margin-left:-14px}
.lk-stc{display:inline-flex;margin-top:var(--s2)}.lk-m3{display:none}
.lk-runs.lk-short>.lk-run:nth-child(n+5){display:none}
.lk-qs.lk-qshort>.lk-fold{display:none}
.lk-lm{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:var(--s2);padding-top:var(--s2)}.lk-lm label{display:flex;gap:var(--s2);align-items:center;min-height:44px;font-size:var(--fs-1)}.lk-lm input{width:22px;height:22px}.lk-lm .lk-lb{display:flex;gap:var(--s2);flex-wrap:wrap}.lk-lm button{min-height:44px;flex:1 1 120px}.lk-lm button.on{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink)}.lk-lm>p{margin:0}
.lk-more{display:block;width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;text-align:center;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-m);padding:var(--s2);font:600 var(--fs-0) var(--font);color:var(--accent);background:var(--bg);cursor:pointer;margin-bottom:var(--s2)}
summary.lk-more{list-style:none}summary.lk-more::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}details[open]>summary.lk-more{display:none}
.lk-q{min-height:48px;padding:6px var(--s3)}.lk-q img{width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:50%;filter:var(--portrait-filter)}.lk-q .lk-n{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);min-width:14px}
.lk-q .t b{font-size:var(--fs-0);font-weight:600}
.idb{font:11px var(--mono);background:var(--grey-bg);color:var(--grey-fg);border-radius:5px;padding:2px 6px;line-height:14px;white-space:nowrap;overflow-wrap:normal}

.lk-yb{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;background:var(--hot-bg);color:var(--hot);border-radius:var(--r-pill);padding:1px 8px;white-space:nowrap}
.lk-wait{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;background:var(--amber-bg);color:var(--amber-fg);border-radius:var(--r-pill);padding:1px 8px;white-space:nowrap}
.lk-idle{background:var(--amber-bg);color:var(--amber-fg);border-radius:6px;padding:4px 8px;font-weight:600}
.lk-ssd{display:inline-block;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;border-radius:var(--r-pill);padding:2px 8px;white-space:nowrap;background:var(--ok-bg);color:var(--ok)}
.lk-ssd.no{background:var(--hot-bg);color:var(--hot)}.lk-ssdl{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:var(--s2);font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}
.lk-rec{display:inline-block;font-size:12px;background:var(--ok-bg);color:var(--ok);border-radius:var(--r-pill);padding:2px 8px}
.lk-pan{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-l);padding:var(--s4);margin-top:var(--s5)}
.lk-pan h2{font-size:var(--fs-4);font-weight:800;margin:0;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;gap:var(--s3);flex-wrap:wrap}
.lk-pan h3{font-size:var(--fs-2);font-weight:800;margin:var(--s4) 0 var(--s2);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;gap:var(--s3);flex-wrap:wrap}

.lk-kind{display:inline-block;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;line-height:16px;border-radius:var(--r-pill);padding:0 7px;white-space:nowrap;overflow-wrap:normal;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);border:1px solid var(--line);margin-right:2px}
.lk-kind.mc{background:var(--pink-bg);color:var(--pink-fg);border-color:var(--pink-bg)}
.lk-sims{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:var(--s3);margin-top:var(--s3)}

class="idb">T-2332</span></div></div><h3 id="lk-path">From Parked back to main<small>read from the code at this build</small></h3><ol class="lk-steps"><li><b>Set aside.</b> A change whose merge checks fail, or that no longer fits on main, is set aside under a parked name, and its lane goes on with new work.</li><li><b>Sorted once an hour.</b> Each task's newest parked work is put on top of current main. Work that no longer fits stays parked; the rest gets a retry line, with the tests its files call for (56 retry lines wait now).</li><li><b>Checked in groups.</b> A group check takes the next retry lines, 6 at a time, stacked one on another, and runs their tests together; the lines that pass go on as one change. It starts at most once every 10 minutes, one run at a time, and needs room to work: a folder on the scratch disk, or 20 GB free on the Mac mini. With neither, it waits.</li><li><b>Or sent back one at a time.</b> Each lane also sends its own retry lines back: onto a free spare branch while fewer than 4 changes wait to merge, else at most once an hour per account.</li><li><b>Merge queue.</b> From there a parked change waits in the same Merge queue as new work and goes through every merge check again.</li></ol><h3 id="lk-order">What they share, and the order<small>parked and new work alike</small></h3><ul class="lk-steps"><li><b>One merge at a time.</b> New work and parked work use the same single merge slot, one change at a time: put on current main, the host checks on the Mac mini, the Simulator check when it changes app code, then onto main. Every other change waits until that one is done.</li><li><b>The Merge queue's order.</b> A change waiting over 60 minutes goes first, oldest first. The rest go cheapest first (no app or engine change, then an engine change, then app code, which needs the Simulator), oldest first among equals. Parked work gets no place of its own in that order, and tasks are taken not by priority.</li><li><b>Simulators.</b> A merge's Simulator check waits in the same Simulator queue as test runs, and the merge slot stays taken while it waits.</li><li><b>The Mac mini.</b> The group check's tests run on the same Mac mini as the merge's host checks and the lanes' own tests, as many at once as its free cores allow.</li><li><b>Passes.</b> A merge pass starts no new change after 10 minutes (50 minutes while a company session runs); the rest wait for the next pass.</li><li><b>So:</b> parked work waits on the hourly sort, then on the group check or its lane, then on the Merge queue; the Merge queue waits on the one merge slot; the merge slot waits on a Simulator when the change has app code.</li></ul></section><script defer src="{{ '/assets/look.js' | relative_url }}"></script><script defer src="{{ '/assets/session.js' | relative_url }}"></script></div>
